notes.title: We have released a Early Access Version DEMO of Flea Market Simulator '24's
notes.content:
[b]v0.2.0-Early Access Patch Notes[/b]
03.23.2024 08:15 PM (GMT +3)

Greetings dear players,
We are working hard for better game with your valuable feedbacks.

[b]Improvements[/b]
Changed game map.
Added random items to floor while game is starting.
Changed post-process.
Added money sound.
Added house FX.
OwnShopUI is updated.
Furniture images are updated.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
NPC Outlines
Animations
Collider Size of Picture

Maybe you need to restart steam client for update. 

We hope you all have fun. [b]Would appreciate your feedback[/b].

notes.title: v0.1.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
03.03.2024 02:30 AM (GMT +3)

[i]Greetings dear players,[/i]
We are working hard for better game with your valuable feedbacks.

[b]Improvements[/b]
Bus Stops are usable now.
Added info message if someone want to buy item.
Added daily report system.
Added notification after buy furnitures.
Added min and max offer while bargaining.
Time is stop if Tutorial opened.
Added "close game" button to settings.
Added 1 furniture for own shop.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed some localized texts.
Better physic collision for hold objects. Before, there is collision between furnitures and hold objects.

Maybe you need to restart steam client for update. 

[i]We hope you all have fun. [/i][b]Would appreciate your feedback.[/b]

notes.title: v0.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
03.01.2024 02:45 AM (GMT +3)

[i]Greetings dear players,[/i]
We are hard working for better game with your valuable feedbacks.

[b]Improvements[/b]
Added helper UI for items which you hold.
Added helper UI for NPCs, furnitures, cars, doors and breakables.
Addeed helper UI for items which you try to put on table in merchants.
Animations and emotions added for angry, yes and no actions while you are bargaining.
Animations added for interactions.
Target indicators won't be shown if you are less than 10 meters away.
Some roads are removed for better performance.
Changed camera distance for better performance.
Better information window after buy car. Cars are spawning on right side of your own shop.
Angry rate while bargaining is dramatically decreased for better QoL.
[i]You can see all helper UIs on left side of screen.[/i]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Chinese Langage Support, now working all characters on fonts.
Selling area bugs, now you can see true item count while you are selling items.
"Skip Night" button, fixed the bug that caused 1 extra day count.
Repairman, fixed foot locations.
Antique Shop, antique dealer is not buying items which is not antique anymore.

Maybe you need to restart steam client for update. 

[i]We hope you all have fun. [/i][b]Would appreciate your feedback.[/b]
